answer_1.quote: Chinese Spelling Check (CSC), which aims to detect and correct spelling errors in Chinese texts, is a fundamental task in Chinese natural language processing.
answer_1.outputs: Corrected Chinese sentences generated by the model.

answer_2.quote: We use the widely adopted sentence-level precision, recall and F1 as our main evaluation metrics. Sentence-level metrics are stricter than character-level metrics since a sentence is considered to be correct if and only if all errors in the sentence are successfully detected and corrected.
